items.prompt: What must an undirected adjacency builder do for input edge (u,v) in this representation?

options.text: Store only u-to-v and infer reverse edges later without code
Merge all vertex IDs into a single label
options.why: Connectivity does not erase vertex identity.

options.text: Store each endpoint in the other's neighbor list
options.why: Traversal needs explicit adjacency in both directions.

options.text: Sort every price by its numeric value
options.why: That does not construct graph connectivity.

items.explanation: Direction is part of the input contract. This undirected representation stores both adjacency directions.
